events.title: Can SMCI Navigate CapEx & Inventory Headwinds Amid Rapid Scale-Up?
events.body: Super Micro Computer ramps up AI infrastructure capacity to 6,000 racks monthly by FY26 as inventory and cash flow pressures intensify.

events.title: Agilysys (AGYS) Q4 Earnings and Revenues Surpass Estimates
events.body: Agilysys (AGYS) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +24.33% and +1.59%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
